analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: We may sometimes share your personal information with third parties (as described below) in order to provide or improve our services, including offering services based on your requirements.

analysis.headline: Shares with Mi Ecosystem
analysis.quote: Xiaomi may disclose your personal information to the Mi Ecosystem companies to provide you with and improve the existing products and services (both hardware and software) from the Mi Ecosystem companies.

analysis.headline: Shares with Affiliated Companies
analysis.quote: In order to successfully conduct business operations and to provide you with all the functions of our services, we may share your personal information from time to time to other Xiaomi affiliates.

analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: To help us provide you with services described in this Privacy Policy, we may, where necessary, share your personal information with our third party service providers and business partners.

analysis.headline: Shares for Legal/Government Requests
analysis.quote: In accordance with legal requirements, legal procedures, litigation and/or requests from public agencies and government agencies, Xiaomi may need to disclose your personal information.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Cookies & IP
analysis.quote: We may collect log information related to your use, such as cookies, IP addresses.

analysis.headline: Your Data Transferred Globally
analysis.quote: For the purposes described in the Privacy Policy, your information may be transferred to these data centers in accordance with applicable law.

analysis.headline: Not Responsible for Third Parties
analysis.quote: We are not responsible for and cannot control how third parties use personal information which they collect from you.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for Research
analysis.quote: An exception to this is personal information that we are processing for public interest, scientific, historical research, or statistical purposes.
